scenarios.label: Balanced baseline
scenarios.detail: All three stages are useful but leave visible room for diagnosis.

scenarios.label: Index coverage drift
scenarios.detail: The reader remains strong, but relevant evidence often never reaches it.

scenarios.label: Reader confusion
scenarios.detail: Retrieval usually succeeds, but the reader selects or formats the wrong answer.

scenarios.label: Unsupported answering
scenarios.detail: Many questions lack support, and the answer gate guesses instead of abstaining.
